description: Behavioral evals for NV-Generate-CTMR rflow-ct synthetic CT generation. Tests config-path handling, preflight use, and synthetic-data scope.

evals.prompt: Generate a synthetic abdomen CT and paired segmentation mask from my config at /data/abdomen_request.json using nv-generate-ct-rflow.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs scripts/run_rflow_ct.py with the user config path, NV_GENERATE_ROOT set or checked, --output-dir, and a deterministic --random-seed.
assertions: the first positional argument is the user-provided config path
the agent states the output is synthetic and not production training data without review

evals.prompt: Before launching rflow-ct inference, check whether this request is valid and estimate cost.
evals.expected_output: The agent should use --preflight-only and report anatomy/config/CUDA/dataset checks rather than launching full inference.
assertions: the agent does NOT download weights or run full inference unless setup is explicitly requested
the final answer surfaces estimated runtime or VRAM caveats when present

baseline_methodology.with_skill_setup: Agent has wrapper command, preflight behavior, and synthetic-data boundaries.
baseline_methodology.without_skill_setup: Agent has upstream generation docs only and may edit upstream configs directly or skip preflight.
baseline_methodology.expected_delta: with_skill: stable wrapper invocation and preflight discipline. without_skill: higher risk of config staging mistakes or unsupported claims.
